summary.text: Lance Ryan is a Republican candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives in the Orange-Washington-Addison District, a two-seat district, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

Ballotpedia reports that he lost the August 11, 2026 Republican primary, finishing third with 115 votes behind Stephen Webster and Charles Russell, and was then selected as a general election replacement candidate after Russell withdrew.
